ins.rule: Target Rules "Any Tile" = the skill is aimed at a tile and affects whatever is on that tile (or in the pattern placed from it): enemy, ally, neutral or object. An empty tile is still a legal aim point and still gets terrain/tile reactions. Applies to every damage and healing skill (single or area) and to the buff/debuff skills that used to be locked to one side: Stone Prison, Seal of Silence, Blinding Flash, Mind Fracture, Wither, Veil of Weakness, Nature's Grasp, Arcane Barrier, Vital Barrier, Weapon Ward, Bastion Projection, Guardian's Projection, Benediction, Invigorate, Arcane Renewal, Purifying Form, Coordinated Advance, Meditate. The old wording "Ground, including occupied Ground" is merged into "Any Tile" (same behaviour, one wording). Friendly fire is the default; any exception must be printed on the card.

Skills: War Cry, Bulwark Field, Consecrate, Sanctify (user ruling). ins.rule: An Augment fits a Skill only by the tags printed on the Skill card - no hidden rules. Required Target Rules are no longer used (all None) and 'target must be enemy/ally' requirements are dropped; Required Pattern is expressed as a Single/Area tag instead (None). Required Skill Tags format: comma-separated entries are ALL required (AND); alternatives inside one entry are joined with ' OR ' (e.g. 'Direct Damage, Single, Ranged'; 'Buff OR Healing OR Support'). Skills whose shape or reach comes from the equipped weapon carry 'Weapon Shape' / 'Weapon Reach'; at runtime these are replaced by the equipped weapon's actual Single/Area and Melee/Ranged tags, and the card shows them. If a weapon swap breaks a fit, the augment greys out and says why (Disarmed does not affect this). Other Requirements is kept only for battle-time conditions (Interrupt, Priority Surge), which are not equip rules. Weapon passives follow the same tags-only rule.

All 16 kill augments (Executioner, Blood Harvest, Soul Harvest, Triumphant Recovery, Purifying Kill, Fortify on Kill, Momentum, Chain Kill, Explosive Death, Shattering Death, Terrifying Death, Toxic Death, Overkill Splash, Soul Echo, Gold Harvest, Treasure Hunter) trigger only when the supported Skill defeats an enemy that was NOT summoned (by a skill, augment or item) and has NOT been revived this battle. Count: mid-battle reinforcements, hostile event units, neutrals that have turned hostile; a Traitor counts if it dies while still an enemy. Do not count: allies, neutrals, objects, summoned units, revived units (Chaos Necromancer's raised undead are revives). Applies both ways. Same definition in trigger_safety TRG-006 / TRG-007 / TRG-008 and in each augment's Kill_Credit_Dependency.

Friendly fire is the default for extra hits. Enemies only (printed on the card): Bounce Shot, Overkill Splash, Toxic Death, Shattering Death, Terrifying Death, Soul Echo. Any side: Piercing Shot (the unit behind the target), Wide Arc (units on the adjacent tiles). Unchanged as written: Mass Purge, Turret Spawn, Holy Ground. Explosive Death and Impact Splash already hit everything.

ins.field_or_topic: Saved units - augments that no longer fit (USER RULING 2026-10-26)
ins.rule: When a save loads, any equipped augment that no longer fits its skill under the tags-only check is unequipped automatically and returned to the inventory. A short notice lists what was removed; its exact wording needs the user's approval before it is added (standing rule: no new helper text without approval). Enemy units need no migration - they are generated fresh each battle from the same check.
